edition.title: The World in Brief · Contextual Cloze · 18 November 2026
edition.summary_zh: 依据11月18日邮件 Today’s top stories 七则短讯，按邮件顺序原创改写，含21道填空及逐题精读解析。
edition.source_label: The Economist · 订阅邮件学习版

items.example: The board chair rejected demands to reinstate Jensen Huang.
items.cloze: The board chair ______ demands to reinstate Jensen Huang.
items.analysis_zh: rejected demands to reinstate 是 reject + 名词 + to do 的结构，表示否定明确的复职要求。报道限定为董事长公开表态，不推断所有股东立场；dismissed 可以描述驳回，但 rejected 更直接对应要求。
items.why_zh: rejected demands to reinstate 是 reject + 名词 + to do 的结构，表示否定明确的复职要求。

imitation.background_zh: 假设合同谈判：客户提出临时降价要求。
imitation.sentence_en: The supplier rejected demands to cut prices immediately.
imitation.translation_zh: 供应商拒绝了立即降价的要求。

items.example: The announcement coincided with quarterly revenue growth of 103% from a year earlier.
items.cloze: The announcement ______ with quarterly revenue growth of 103% from a year earlier.
items.analysis_zh: coincided with 后接名词短语，指出公告与季度营收同比增长103%的时间重合。coincide 不直接表示因果，不能写成财报导致董事长决定；它是不及物动词，后接 with。
items.why_zh: coincided with 后接名词短语，指出公告与季度营收同比增长103%的时间重合。

imitation.background_zh: 假设项目管理：交付日恰逢年度盘点。
imitation.sentence_en: The delivery coincided with the annual inventory count.
imitation.translation_zh: 交付恰逢年度库存盘点。

items.example: The company's market value had shrunk by about $250bn since Huang resigned.
items.cloze: The company's market value had ______ by about $250bn since Huang resigned.
items.analysis_zh: had shrunk by 表示到报道时已经累计减少某个金额，过去完成时对应此前辞职以来的变化。shrink by 指减少幅度，shrink to 指剩余规模；市值缩水也不等于公司发生同额经营亏损。
items.why_zh: had shrunk by 表示到报道时已经累计减少某个金额，过去完成时对应此前辞职以来的变化。

imitation.background_zh: 假设投资复盘：观察公司估值变化。
imitation.sentence_en: Its valuation had shrunk by a fifth before the recovery.
imitation.translation_zh: 复苏之前，它的估值已缩水五分之一。

items.example: Xi Jinping urged countries to defend open trade at the Shenzhen summit.
items.cloze: Xi Jinping ______ countries to defend open trade at the Shenzhen summit.
items.analysis_zh: urged countries to defend 属于 urge + 宾语 + to do，表示领导人敦促其他国家行动。比 suggested 语气更强，但仍是讲话倡议，不证明参会国已达成共同决定。
items.why_zh: urged countries to defend 属于 urge + 宾语 + to do，表示领导人敦促其他国家行动。

imitation.background_zh: 假设项目协作：催促伙伴确认计划。
imitation.sentence_en: The manager urged partners to confirm the timetable.
imitation.translation_zh: 经理敦促伙伴确认时间表。

items.example: Xi portrayed China as a source of stability in the multilateral trading system.
items.cloze: Xi ______ China as a source of stability in the multilateral trading system.
items.analysis_zh: portrayed China as a source of stability 使用 portray A as B，表示讲话者塑造的形象。新闻应归因于演讲内容，不能将自我定位直接视为客观结论；presented 也能自然表达这一展示行为。
items.why_zh: portrayed China as a source of stability 使用 portray A as B，表示讲话者塑造的形象。

imitation.background_zh: 假设英文演讲：描述试点项目。
imitation.sentence_en: The speaker portrayed the pilot as a model for expansion.
imitation.translation_zh: 演讲者将试点项目描绘为扩张范例。

items.example: Putin criticised sanctions on Russia and attacked Western powers in his speech.
items.cloze: Putin ______ sanctions on Russia and attacked Western powers in his speech.
items.analysis_zh: criticised sanctions on Russia 中 criticise 是及物动词，直接接批评对象，on Russia 修饰 sanctions。英式 criticised 与美式 criticized 均正确；句子只记录发言，不为其政治判断背书。
items.why_zh: criticised sanctions on Russia 中 criticise 是及物动词，直接接批评对象，on Russia 修饰 sanctions。

imitation.background_zh: 假设合同评审：法务批评出口限制。
imitation.sentence_en: The legal team criticised the proposed export restrictions.
imitation.translation_zh: 法务团队批评了拟议的出口限制。

items.example: Xi greeted Donald Trump at Shenzhen airport before planned talks.
items.cloze: Xi ______ Donald Trump at Shenzhen airport before planned talks.
items.analysis_zh: greeted somebody at the airport 是迎接来访者的常见搭配。报道明确的是机场礼宾动作，不能直接推断外交关系改善；welcomed 同样符合接待语境，但情感色彩略强。
items.why_zh: greeted somebody at the airport 是迎接来访者的常见搭配。

imitation.background_zh: 假设商务接待：迎接海外工程师。
imitation.sentence_en: The host greeted visiting engineers at the factory.
imitation.translation_zh: 接待人员在工厂迎接来访工程师。

items.example: The airport reception signalled a departure from Xi's usual diplomatic protocol.
items.cloze: The airport reception ______ a departure from Xi's usual diplomatic protocol.
items.analysis_zh: signalled a departure from 表示某个行为体现了偏离惯例的信号；departure from 在这里指做法变化。signalled 不等于证实政策改变，美式 signaled 也成立。
items.why_zh: signalled a departure from 表示某个行为体现了偏离惯例的信号；departure from 在这里指做法变化。

imitation.background_zh: 假设项目会议：高层参与改变惯例。
imitation.sentence_en: The director's presence signalled a departure from normal practice.
imitation.translation_zh: 总监出席显示做法有别于惯例。

items.example: Trump had previously pledged to deepen defence co-operation with the Philippines.
items.cloze: Trump had previously ______ to deepen defence co-operation with the Philippines.
items.analysis_zh: had pledged to deepen 是过去完成时加 pledge to do，标记抵华前作出的正式承诺。承诺属于政策表态，不能据此认定合作已经深化；promised 语气稍普通，vowed 更强调决心。
items.why_zh: had pledged to deepen 是过去完成时加 pledge to do，标记抵华前作出的正式承诺。

imitation.background_zh: 假设英语学习：课程开始前承诺练习。
imitation.sentence_en: She had pledged to practise speaking daily.
imitation.translation_zh: 她此前承诺每天练习口语。

items.example: Annual consumer-price inflation accelerated to 3.6% in October from 3.5% in September.
items.cloze: Annual consumer-price inflation ______ to 3.6% in October from 3.5% in September.
items.analysis_zh: accelerated to 3.6% from 3.5% 说明通胀率从旧水平升至新水平，to 与 from 分别标记终点和起点。通胀加速表示价格上涨速度变快，不能理解为物价下降；rose 也符合数字变化。
items.why_zh: accelerated to 3.6% from 3.5% 说明通胀率从旧水平升至新水平，to 与 from 分别标记终点和起点。

imitation.background_zh: 假设宏观研究：能源成本推动通胀。
imitation.sentence_en: Inflation accelerated to 4% after fuel costs rose.
imitation.translation_zh: 燃料成本上涨后，通胀率升至4%。

items.example: The increase was largely attributed to higher energy costs linked to the Iran war.
items.cloze: The increase was largely ______ to higher energy costs linked to the Iran war.
items.analysis_zh: was largely attributed to 是被动语态，表示主要归因于某个因素；largely 保留其他因素可能存在的空间。attribute to 是中性归因结构，blame on 则更强调责任归咎。
items.why_zh: was largely attributed to 是被动语态，表示主要归因于某个因素；largely 保留其他因素可能存在的空间。

imitation.background_zh: 假设供应链分析：解释成本增长。
imitation.sentence_en: The increase was largely attributed to freight charges.
imitation.translation_zh: 上涨主要归因于运费。

items.example: The figures could prompt the Bank of England to raise rates again.
items.cloze: The figures could ______ the Bank of England to raise rates again.
items.analysis_zh: could prompt somebody to do 表示可能促使机构采取行动，could 明确保留不确定性。prompt 强调数据可能触发决策，不能用强制性更高的 force 来断言央行没有选择。
items.why_zh: could prompt somebody to do 表示可能促使机构采取行动，could 明确保留不确定性。

imitation.background_zh: 假设项目风险：延误可能引发计划调整。
imitation.sentence_en: Repeated delays could prompt the team to revise its plan.
imitation.translation_zh: 反复延误可能促使团队修改计划。

items.example: Ukraine targeted the bridge between Russia and Crimea with missiles and drones.
items.cloze: Ukraine ______ the bridge between Russia and Crimea with missiles and drones.
items.analysis_zh: targeted the bridge with missiles and drones 采用 target + 目标 + with + 手段，明确攻击对象与工具。target 为及物动词，无需 target at；句子没有推断更广泛的军事目的。
items.why_zh: targeted the bridge with missiles and drones 采用 target + 目标 + with + 手段，明确攻击对象与工具。

imitation.background_zh: 假设网络演练：模拟攻击关键服务器。
imitation.sentence_en: The exercise targeted a server with repeated requests.
imitation.translation_zh: 演练通过反复请求攻击一台服务器。

items.example: The damage disrupted an important supply route for Russian forces.
items.cloze: The damage ______ an important supply route for Russian forces.
items.analysis_zh: disrupted an important supply route 表示运输路线运作受影响。disrupt 比 destroy 克制，桥梁部分坍塌不能自动等同于整个供应网络永久消失；interrupted 可表示运输中断。
items.why_zh: disrupted an important supply route 表示运输路线运作受影响。

imitation.background_zh: 假设生产计划：停电影响物料配送。
imitation.sentence_en: The outage disrupted deliveries to the assembly line.
imitation.translation_zh: 停电影响了装配线的物料配送。

items.example: The Kremlin vowed to rebuild the damaged crossing after the strike.
items.cloze: The Kremlin ______ to rebuild the damaged crossing after the strike.
items.analysis_zh: vowed to rebuild 采用 vow + to do，表示强烈的公开未来承诺。新闻只能确认当局作出承诺，不能推断重建已完成；pledged 也适合正式承诺，vowed 的决心语气更强。
items.why_zh: vowed to rebuild 采用 vow + to do，表示强烈的公开未来承诺。

imitation.background_zh: 假设灾后修复：官员承诺重建道路。
imitation.sentence_en: Officials vowed to rebuild the road after flooding.
imitation.translation_zh: 官员承诺在洪水后重建道路。

items.example: The NSA reported a temporary network degradation during planned maintenance.
items.cloze: The NSA reported a temporary network ______ during planned maintenance.
items.analysis_zh: network degradation 指网络服务质量或性能下降，temporary 限定其持续时间。它不必然意味着全面离线；outage 通常表示服务中断，degradation 更适合报道中的谨慎技术措辞。
items.why_zh: network degradation 指网络服务质量或性能下降，temporary 限定其持续时间。

imitation.background_zh: 假设系统运维：维护期间响应变慢。
imitation.sentence_en: Engineers observed network degradation during maintenance.
imitation.translation_zh: 工程师在维护期间观察到网络性能下降。

items.example: Apple acknowledged that a software update had caused internal outages.
items.cloze: Apple ______ that a software update had caused internal outages.
items.analysis_zh: acknowledged that + 从句用于机构正式确认事实，had caused 以过去完成时说明更新在声明前引发问题。admitted 有时带被迫承认的色彩，acknowledged 更适合中性新闻归因。
items.why_zh: acknowledged that + 从句用于机构正式确认事实，had caused 以过去完成时说明更新在声明前引发问题。

imitation.background_zh: 假设软件项目：承认更新影响报表。
imitation.sentence_en: The developer acknowledged that the update had affected reports.
imitation.translation_zh: 开发人员承认更新影响了报表。

items.example: Both organisations denied that cyber-attacks had caused the problems.
items.cloze: Both organisations ______ that cyber-attacks had caused the problems.
items.analysis_zh: denied that + 完整从句明确表示两家机构否认网络攻击是原因。否认是当事机构的声明，不能等同独立调查的最终结论；deny 后接 that 从句，不能机械换成 deny to do。
items.why_zh: denied that + 完整从句明确表示两家机构否认网络攻击是原因。

imitation.background_zh: 假设合同沟通：否认系统导致延误。
imitation.sentence_en: The supplier denied that its system had caused the delay.
imitation.translation_zh: 供应商否认其系统造成了延误。

items.example: Lawmakers elected Matan Kahana as the new speaker of parliament.
items.cloze: Lawmakers ______ Matan Kahana as the new speaker of parliament.
items.analysis_zh: elected somebody as speaker 表示通过选举使某人担任议长，as 引出职位。elect 强调投票程序，appoint 更常指任命；这里报道的是议会选举结果。
items.why_zh: elected somebody as speaker 表示通过选举使某人担任议长，as 引出职位。

imitation.background_zh: 假设社团活动：成员投票选主席。
imitation.sentence_en: Members elected a chair at their annual meeting.
imitation.translation_zh: 成员在年度会议上选出一名主席。

items.example: The result strengthened the opposition's influence over the legislative agenda.
items.cloze: The result ______ the opposition's influence over the legislative agenda.
items.analysis_zh: strengthened influence over the legislative agenda 表示对立法议程的影响力增加，over 引出影响范围。influence 不等于 control，不能据此断言反对派已掌握政府全部权力。
items.why_zh: strengthened influence over the legislative agenda 表示对立法议程的影响力增加，over 引出影响范围。

imitation.background_zh: 假设项目治理：新增席位提升团队话语权。
imitation.sentence_en: The new seat strengthened engineers' influence over design.
imitation.translation_zh: 新增席位增强了工程师对设计的影响力。

items.example: Gadi Eisenkot received the first chance to assemble a viable government.
items.cloze: Gadi Eisenkot received the first chance to ______ a viable government.
items.analysis_zh: assemble a viable government 指通过协调政党形成能够运作的政府，viable 强调可行性。received the first chance 仅说明优先组阁权，不能宣称已成功组阁；form 也符合此句。
items.why_zh: assemble a viable government 指通过协调政党形成能够运作的政府，viable 强调可行性。

imitation.background_zh: 假设跨部门项目：组建能执行任务的团队。
imitation.sentence_en: The manager was asked to assemble a viable project team.
imitation.translation_zh: 经理被要求组建一支能够运作的项目团队。

passages.title: Nvidia board rejects a leadership reversal
passages.body: The board chair {{2026-11-18-nvidia-rejected}} demands to reinstate Jensen Huang. The announcement {{2026-11-18-nvidia-coincided}} with quarterly revenue growth of 103% from a year earlier. The company's market value had {{2026-11-18-nvidia-shrunk}} by about $250bn since Huang resigned. The development drew attention because it could affect decisions beyond the immediate announcement.

passages.title: APEC leaders offer competing accounts of global trade
passages.body: Xi Jinping {{2026-11-18-apec-urged}} countries to defend open trade at the Shenzhen summit. Xi {{2026-11-18-apec-portrayed}} China as a source of stability in the multilateral trading system. Putin {{2026-11-18-apec-criticised}} sanctions on Russia and attacked Western powers in his speech. The development drew attention because it could affect decisions beyond the immediate announcement.

passages.title: Unusual airport welcome precedes talks in China
passages.body: Xi {{2026-11-18-summit-greeted}} Donald Trump at Shenzhen airport before planned talks. The airport reception {{2026-11-18-summit-signalled}} a departure from Xi's usual diplomatic protocol. Trump had previously {{2026-11-18-summit-pledged}} to deepen defence co-operation with the Philippines. The development drew attention because it could affect decisions beyond the immediate announcement.

passages.title: British inflation raises the prospect of further tightening
passages.body: Annual consumer-price inflation {{2026-11-18-inflation-accelerated}} to 3.6% in October from 3.5% in September. The increase was largely {{2026-11-18-inflation-attributed}} to higher energy costs linked to the Iran war. The figures could {{2026-11-18-inflation-prompt}} the Bank of England to raise rates again. The development drew attention because it could affect decisions beyond the immediate announcement.

passages.title: Missile and drone strike damages the Kerch bridge
passages.body: Ukraine {{2026-11-18-crimea-targeted}} the bridge between Russia and Crimea with missiles and drones. The damage {{2026-11-18-crimea-disrupted}} an important supply route for Russian forces. The Kremlin {{2026-11-18-crimea-vowed}} to rebuild the damaged crossing after the strike. The development drew attention because it could affect decisions beyond the immediate announcement.

passages.title: Separate technical failures hit the NSA and Apple
passages.body: The NSA reported a temporary network {{2026-11-18-outages-degradation}} during planned maintenance. Apple {{2026-11-18-outages-acknowledged}} that a software update had caused internal outages. Both organisations {{2026-11-18-outages-denied}} that cyber-attacks had caused the problems. The development drew attention because it could affect decisions beyond the immediate announcement.

passages.title: Opposition gains influence in Israel's parliament
passages.body: Lawmakers {{2026-11-18-israel-elected}} Matan Kahana as the new speaker of parliament. The result {{2026-11-18-israel-strengthened}} the opposition's influence over the legislative agenda. Gadi Eisenkot received the first chance to {{2026-11-18-israel-assemble}} a viable government. The development drew attention because it could affect decisions beyond the immediate announcement.
